items.title: Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager/ Manager Technical Solutions – Cloud Engineer
items.doc_text:
भारत सरकार | Government of India Screen Reader Access A + A A - Skip to content Openings Details Digital India BHASHINI Division (Digital India Corporation) invites applications for the post of Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager / Manager (Technical Solutions – Cloud Engineer) on a contractual basis. Position Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager / Manager (Technical Solutions – Cloud Engineer) No. of Positions 01 Last Date 15th November 2026 Responsibilities 1. Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-availability technical solutions inspired by large digital platforms. 2. Translate business and functional requirements into end-to-end technical architectures and solution designs. 3. Support onboarding and integration of partner applications and services into the platform ecosystem. 4. Architect and manage cloud infrastructure for AI, data, and application workloads. 5. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, and Ansible. 6. Implement best practices in cloud operations, including autoscaling, configuration management, and cost optimization. 7. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for platform and application deployments. 8. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud and application environments for performance and reliability. 9. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints for internal teams and partners. 10. Work closely with internal teams to identify gaps, improve processes, and enhance solution delivery. 11. Deliver exceptional customer service by leveraging strong communication and analytical skills in a client facing role. 12. Analytical mindset with a solution-oriented approach to complex challenges. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering practical solutions. 13. Be flexible and available to travel as and when required to meet business needs. Important Links Download Detailed Notification Click Here Apply Here Click Here Official Website Click Here About Bhashini The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) under the Digital India Program has undertaken a unique initiative, BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission. Mission Bhashini was launched by the Hon’ble PM on 4th July 2022 during Digital India Week 2022 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The vision of Bhashini is to “Harness natural language technologies to enable a diverse ecosystem of contributors, partnering entities, and citizens for the purpose of transcending language barriers, thereby ensuring digital inclusion and digital empowerment in an Aatma Nirbhar Bharat.” Job Features Job Category Open Job, Software & IT, whatsnew
 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                              
 
Page 1 of 3 
  
 
 
                                                           Adv. No.- DIB/36/2023-DIB/06 
DIGITAL INDIA BHASHINI DIVISION (DIBD)-DIC 
Delhi Office: Electronics Niketan, 6 CGO Complex, Lodhi Road, New Delhi - 110003 
Tel.: +91 (11) 24360199 / 24301756 
Website:  https://BHASHINI.gov.in/ 
 
WEB ADVERTISEMENT 
 
30th October 2026 
 
The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) under the Digital India Program has undertaken a unique 
initiative, BHASHINI, the National Language Translation Mission. Mission BHASHINI was launched by Hon’ble PM on 4 th 
July 2022 during Digital India Week 2022 in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. Vision of BHASHINI is to “Harness natural language 
technologies to enable a diverse ecosystem of contributors, partnering entities and citizens for the purpose of 
transcending language barriers, thereby ensuring digital inclusion and digital empowerment in an Aatma Nirbhar Bharat.”  
 
In order to build this ecosystem, The Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD), an Independent Business Division under 
Digital India Corporation (DIC). The DIBD is managing and executing the activities of “National Language Translation 
Mission”: BHASHINI. BHASHINI (https://www.BHASHINI.gov.in) has been developed as a platform where various 
components have been integrated to bring stakeholders together. BHASHINI works with some of the premier academic 
institutes, including IITs and IIITs) in India. These institutes are developing state of the art language AI models for various 
Indian languages. BHASHINI platform already hosts 300+ AI based language models in various technologies. 
 
Digital India Corporation/ BHASHINI is currently inviting applications for the following positions purely on Contract/ 
Consolidated basis. 
 
Sr. No. Name of the Post* No. of Vacancies 
1. Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager/ Manager Technical Solutions – Cloud Engineer 01 
* The designation shall be allocated based on the candidate’s experience level. 
 
Screening of applications will be based on qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Digital India 
BHASHINI Division (DIBD)-Digital India Corporation (DIC) reserves the right to fix higher threshold of qualifications and 
experience for screening and limiting the number of candidates for interview. Only shortlisted candidates shall be invited 
for selection interviews. DIBD-DIC reserves the right to not to select any of the candidates without assigning any reason 
thereof. 
 
The details can be downloaded from the official website of MeitY, DIC, BHASHINI & NeGD viz. www.meity.gov.in & 
www.dic.gov.in , www.BHASHINI.gov.in and www.negd.gov.in 
 
 
 
 
Eligible candidates may apply ONLINE: https://ora.digitalindiacorporation.in/ 
 
Last Date of Application: 15.11.2026 
 
 
 
 
 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                              
 
Page 2 of 3 
  
1. Job Title – Assistant Manager/ Deputy Manager/ Manager Technical Solution- Cloud Engineer 
Division: Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) Age: Maximum Age for Application is 58 Years 
No of Post: 01 
Remuneration: Salaries for this position would depend on the 
qualification and experience of the selected candidate and 
will be fixed as per the industry norms. 
Location: Noida/Delhi or other locations as per 
Project requirements* Reports To: CEO-DIBD 
* Candidates from other locations may also be considered for the role if deemed suitable. 
 
Job Description 
We are looking for a Cloud Engineer to design, implement, and manage scalable cloud infrastructure. You will 
ensure systems are secure, reliable, and optimized for performance while supporting application deployment and 
operations. 
This role is ideal for someone with strong cloud platform knowledge, scripting skills, and experience with modern 
tools, along with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. 
 
Role & Responsibilities 
1. Design and implement scalable, secure, and high -availability technical solutions inspired by large digital 
platforms. 
2. Translate business and functional requirements into end -to-end technical architectures and solution 
designs. 
3. Support onboarding and integration of partner applications and services into the platform ecosystem. 
4. Architect and manage cloud infrastructure for AI, data, and application workloads. 
5. Develop and maintain Infrastructu re-as-Code (IaC) and automation using tools like Terraform, 
CloudFormation, and Ansible. 
6. Implement best practices in cloud operations including autoscaling, configuration management, and cost 
optimization. 
7. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for platform and application deployments. 
8. Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize cloud and application environments for performance and reliability. 
9. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints for internal 
teams and partners. 
10. Work closely with internal teams to identify gaps, improve processes, and enhance solution delivery. 
11. Deliver exceptional customer service by leveraging strong communication and analytical skills in a client-
facing role. 
12. Analytical mindset with a solution-oriented approach to complex challenges. Strong problem-solving skills 
with a focus on delivering practical solutions. 
13. Be flexible and available to travel as and when required to meet business needs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
                                                                                                                                                                                                              
 
Page 3 of 3 
  
Required Profile  
Essential 
Qualificat
ion &  
Experienc
e 
• A Full time B.S./B.Tech. /B.E. or equivalent degree or B.Sc. (IT/CS) with a Post-Graduation in 
a Technical Background may be considered. 
• MBA/M. Tech (Preferable) 
• 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and implementing cloud-based solutions using 
AWS, Azure, or GCP, including compute, storage, networking, and security services. 
• Strong proficiency with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker 
and Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, and service networking would be an 
added advantage. 
• Proven experience in Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation using tools like 
Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet is preferred. 
• Solid understanding of cloud networking (VPC/VNet, subnets, routing, load balancers, 
firewalls) and data platforms (SQL/NoSQL databases, caching systems) is a plus. 
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability tools, and applying DevOps 
practices for high-availability and performance optimization. 
• Formal educational qualificat ions and experience may be relaxed for exceptional 
candidates.  
Note: Candidates selected in this interview could be considered for other vacant positions at DIBD -DIC requiring 
similar skill sets and at appropriate level.  
 
General Conditions applicable to all applicants covered under this advertisement: 
 
1.    Those candidates, who are already in regular or contractual employment under Central / State 
Government, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies, are expected to apply through 
proper channel o r attach a ‘No Objection Certificate’ from the employer concerned with the 
application OR produce No Objection Certificate at the time of interview. 
2.    DIBD-Digital India Corporation reserves the right to fill all or some or none of the positions 
advertised without assigning any reason as it deems fit. 
3.    The positions are purely temporary in nature for the project of DIBD-Digital India Corporation and 
the appointees shall not derive any right or claim for permanent appointment at DIBD-Digital India 
Corporation or on any vacancies existing or that shall be advertised for recruitment by DIBD -
Digital India Corporation in future. 
4.   DIBD-Digital India Corporation reserves the right to terminate the appointments of all positions 
with notice of one month or without any notice by paying one month’s salary in lieu of the notice 
period. 
5.    The maximum age shall be as on the last date of receipt of the applications. Screening of 
applications will be based on qualifications, age academic record and relevant experience. 
6. In case of a query, the following officer may be contacted 
 
Ms. Vinaya Viswanathan 
Director- HR 
DIBD-Digital India Corporation 
Electronics Niketan Annexe, 
6 CGO, Complex Lodhi Road, 
New Delhi – 110003 
Phone No. 011-24303500, 24360199

items.title: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out For 215 Posts, Apply Online
items.description: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out For 215 Posts, Apply Online October 30, 2026
items.doc_text: Exams » Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 The University of Delhi (DU) has announced 215 vacancies for Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 (Non-Teaching) posts under DU Assistant Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates can submit their online applications by 19 November 2026 through the official website, www.du.ac.in. The recruitment offers an opportunity for graduates with the required work experience to join the University of Delhi. DU Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification Out The University of Delhi has released the Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification (Advt. No. R&P/325/2026), announcing 215 vacancies for the Assistant post. Candidates must possess a bachelor’s degree along with at least two years of relevant work experience to be eligible. The selection process includes a Preliminary Test, Main Examination, Skill/Typing Test and further recruitment formalities.Candidates should carefully check their eligibility and enter accurate details before submitting the application form. A direct link to download the notification PDF has been given below: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026- Notification PDF Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 : Overview Candidates can check the key details of DU Assistant Recruitment 2026, including the post name, total vacancies, eligibility, selection process and application deadline, in the table below. Particulars Details Organization University of Delhi Post Name Assistant (Non-Teaching) Total Vacancies 215 Advertisement Number R&P/325/2026 Job Category Non-Teaching Application Mode Online Educational Qualification Bachelor’s Degree Required Experience 2 Years Maximum Age Limit 32 Years Selection Process Prelims, Mains, Skill/Typing Test, Document Verification Last Date to Apply 19 November 2026 Official Website www.du.ac.in DU Assistant Vacancy 2026 The University of Delhi has announced a total of 215 vacancies for the Assistant (Non-Teaching) post under Advertisement No. R&P/325/2026. The vacancies are distributed among different categories as per the reservation rules. Candidates can check the category-wise vacancy details below. Category Number of Vacancies Unreserved (UR) 164 Scheduled Caste (SC) 33 Scheduled Tribe (ST) 18 Total 215 DU Assistant Eligibility Criteria 2026 Candidates applying for Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification, work experience, age limit and skill requirements. The detailed eligibility criteria are given below. Educational Qualification – Candidates must have a Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognised University or Institute. Work Experience Candidates must have at least 2 years of work experience as a Junior Assistant or in an equivalent post. The experience must be from a University, Government Department, PSU, Autonomous Body or an eligible private company. For private companies, the organisation must have an annual turnover of ₹200 Crore or more, and the candidate must have worked in an equivalent pay scale. Computer Proficiency and Typing Speed Candidates must fulfil the following skill requirements: Computer proficiency is mandatory. English Typing Speed: 35 words per minute (WPM). Hindi Typing Speed: 30 words per minute (WPM). Candidates must possess the prescribed typing speed in either English or Hindi. Application Fee Candidates can check the fee details: General / Unreserved: ₹1,000 OBC (NCL) / EWS / All Female Candidates: ₹800 SC / ST / PwBD: ₹600 Exemption: Candidates who applied previously under Advertisement No. R&P/311/2024 are exempt from paying the fee again. DU Assistant Apply Online 2026 The University of Delhi has invited online applications for 215 Assistant (Non-Teaching) vacancies. Eligible candidates can apply through the official DU website by completing the registration process, filling in the application form, uploading the required documents and paying the applicable application fee. The last date to submit the online application is 19 November 2026. Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026- Apply Now How to Apply Online for DU Assistant Recruitment 2026? Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can complete the DU Assistant application process online through the official website. Follow the steps given below to submit the application form successfully. Visit the official website of the University of Delhi at du.ac.in. Navigate to the Work with DU section and click on Advertisement – Departments. Find the link for Assistant Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. R&P/325/2026). Complete the registration process using a valid email ID and mobile number. Log in and fill out the application form with personal details, educational qualifications and two years of work experience. Upload the required documents, recent photograph and signature in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable application fee through the online payment facility. Review the application form carefully and submit it before 19 November 2026. Download and take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference. Selection Process The recruitment process includes multiple stages: Preliminary Test (MCQ): Covers General Studies, Reasoning, Mathematical Ability, and Administration of Higher Educational Institutions. Main Examination (Descriptive): Focuses on core administrative topics, financial administration, FR/SR rules, and GFR. Skill / Typing Test: Qualifying test to verify the required typing speeds. Document Verification & Medical Examination Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026: FAQs Q1. How many vacancies are announced under DU Assistant Recruitment 2026? A total of 215 vacancies have been announced for the Assistant (Non-Teaching) post. Q2. When was the DU Assistant Recruitment 2026 Notification released? The notification was released on 29 October 2026 under Advertisement No. R&P/325/2026. Q3. What is the last date to apply for Delhi University Assistant Recruitment? The last date to apply online is 19 November 2026, or two weeks from the date of publication in Employment News, whichever is later. Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the DU Assistant post? Candidates must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognised University or Institute. Q5. Is work experience mandatory for DU Assistant Recruitment 2026? Yes, candidates must have at least two years of experience as a Junior Assistant or in an equivalent post in an eligible organisation. Q6. What is the maximum age limit for Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026? The maximum age limit is 32 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Government rules. Q7. What is the application fee for DU Assistant Recruitment 2026? The application fee is ₹1,000 for General candidates, ₹800 for OBC (NCL), EWS and female candidates, and ₹600 for SC, ST and PwBD candidates. Q8. What is the selection process for DU Assistant Recruitment 2026? The selection process includes a Preliminary Test, Main Examination, Skill/Typing Test, Document Verification and Medical Examination. Q9. What is the required typing speed for the DU Assistant post? Candidates must have a typing speed of 35 WPM in English or 30 WPM in Hindi. Q10. What is the official website to apply for DU Assistant Recruitment 2026?
